metadata.spectrum_label: R2 fixed-count catalogue: delta=0.35, Gamma=0.65, eta=1e-08
metadata.phonon_label: synthetic Debye: 30 modes in N0*Delta0 units; explicit IR cutoff
metadata.recombination_counting: ordered continuous domain Ei<=Ej; the diagonal has zero integration measure
metadata.electron_reconstruction: piecewise-linear E(x) and R2/N1 on native count nodes; no extrapolation
metadata.electron_stoichiometry: two positive native-energy barycentric weights per virtual electron
metadata.electron_activities: unnormalized geometric Pauli activities using the same stoichiometric weights
metadata.support_limitation: The small intervals outside first/last native count nodes are excluded explicitly; tail/error diagnostics are mandatory
metadata.partition_policy: alpha*(1-chi) native pair quadrature plus alpha*chi nested quadrature; chi is a C2 quintic smooth step
